question: The Sadir dancer R Muthukannammal is the recipient of which of the following awards in the year 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Padma Shri Award**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **R Muthukannammal**, a renowned Sadir dancer, was honored with the **Padma Shri Award** in the year 2022.
 
• The **Padma Shri** is the fourth highest civilian award in India, given for distinguished contributions in various fields including arts, education, industry, literature, science, sports, medicine, social service, and public affairs.
 
• Muthukannammal has been instrumental in preserving and promoting the traditional dance form of Sadir, which is the precursor to Bharatanatyam.
 
• Her dedication and contributions to the art form have been recognized nationally, bringing attention and respect to this cultural heritage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Padma Awards** are announced annually on the eve of Republic Day and are conferred by the President of India at a ceremonial function held at Rashtrapati Bhavan.
 
• The awards are given in three categories: **Padma Vibhushan** (for exceptional and distinguished service), **Padma Bhushan** (for distinguished service of higher order), and **Padma Shri** (for distinguished service).
 
• Established in 1954, the Padma Awards are among the highest civilian honors in India, aimed at recognizing achievements in all fields of activities or disciplines where an element of public service is involved.
 
• Recipients of the Padma Awards are selected by a committee constituted by the Prime Minister of India.
